 W elcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the AFC Champions League Two match between East Bengal and Al Seeb, being played in Oman on Tuesday.
 East Bengal comes into the match after a 5-1 win against Churchill Brothers but is yet to win a match in this season’s ACL 2.
 Starting lineups: 
 Al Seeb Club: Muatasim Al Wahaibi; Majid Al Saadi, Mohammed Al Musalami, Ali Al Busaidi, Hassan Al Ajmi; Ahmed Al Riyami, Abdul Aziz Al Maqbali, Abdul Mageed Al Balushi, A. Oladapo, Fahad Khamis; A. Méyé.
 East Bengal FC: P. Lachenpa; A. Ali, L. Chnungnunga, D. Živulić, J. Gupta; E. Lalrindika, J. Singh, B. Singh, Mohammed Rashid; Dani Ramírez, D. Lallhansanga.
 Match Overview: 
 Date: October 27, 2026
 Venue: Al Seeb Stadium, Oman
 Kick off time: 8 pm local time (9:30 pm IST)
 Referee: Alexander King
 Key Updates
 Starting lineups: East Bengal
 Starting lineups: Al Seeb Club

 East Bengal tries one of the most conventional approaches for an attack: crosses. Bipin sends in a cross from the right, with Edmund and David in the box. Al Seeb spots the ball and clears it away.

 The response of the fans have been rather lukewarm, but the small number of fans in the Al Seeb Stadium are making sure that the home team does not miss a full house with Omani music and chants.

 October 27, 2026 21:31 
 Kick Off!
 East Bengal gets the ball rolling from right to left, while Al Seeb starts from the other end. On paper, the Red-and-Gold Brigade is starting in a 4-4-2 formation with Edmund Lalrindika and David Lalhlansanga Hmar leading the attack.
 October 27, 2026 21:27 
 Minutes to kick off!
 The players walk onto the field and queue up for the pre-match formalities. East Bengal starts in its white away kit while Al Seeb is sporting is yellow home kit.
 October 27, 2026 21:18 
 Pre-match comments: EBFC
 “We could’ve won a match in the ACL Two before, but we suffered due to concentration lapses. We are a well-settled unit and have played a lot of games this season.
“We’ve been creating a lot of chances. It’s all about capitalising on your strengths and rectifying your past errors,” East Bengal’s midfielder Dani Ramirez said.
 October 27, 2026 21:06 
 All Indian attack for East Bengal!
 Antonio Lopez Habas looks to be working really well to push for Indian forwards at the Asian level. David Hmar, Edmund and Bipin Singh form the front three for East Bengal, despite the team having players like Ake Loba and Zwolinski, both of whom scored in their previous match.
 October 27, 2026 20:51 
 Starting lineups: East Bengal
 P. Lachenpa; A. Ali, L. Chnungnunga, D. Živulić, J. Gupta;, Jeakson Singh, Mohammed Rashid, Dani Ramírez, Bipin Singh, D. Lallhansanga, E. Lalrindika.
 October 27, 2026 20:51 
 Starting lineups: Al Seeb Club
 Muatasim Al Wahaibi; Majid Al Saadi, Mohammed Al Musalami, Ali Al Busaidi, Hassan Al Ajmi; Ahmed Al Riyami, Abdul Aziz Al Maqbali, Abdul Mageed Al Balushi, A. Oladapo, Fahad Khamis; A. Méyé.
 October 27, 2026 20:48 
 What does coach Habas have to say before the match?
 “It’s a crucial match for both teams because both of us need to win to stay alive in this tournament. It’s a great opportunity for us to become the first Indian club to win an ACL Two game. We have to be focused through the 90 minutes and avoid defensive lapses.”
 October 27, 2026 20:11 
 East Bengal arrives at the stadium
 East Bengal has reached the Al Seeb Stadium in Oman for its third group-stage match in the AFC Champions League 2. The game kicks off in over a hour.
 October 27, 2026 20:08 
 Match preview
 East Bengal FC will look for its first win in the AFC Champions League (ACL) Two 2026-27 when it takes on Oman’s Al-Seeb in its third group-stage match at the Al-Seeb Stadium on Tuesday, October 27.
 The Red-and-Gold Brigade will be keen to translate its domestic consistency into a positive result on the continental stage, having won its first MG Indian Super League fixtures comprehensively - 4-0 against Churchill Brothers in Goa and 5-1 against Inter Kashi in Pune.
 East Bengal began its ACL Two Group D campaign with a 2-2 draw against Jordan’s Al-Hussein SC in Amman last month, before suffering a narrow 2-3 defeat to Iraq’s Al-Shorta SC in Kolkata. It now heads into this crucial encounter on the back of a demanding run of fixtures on the road.
